  "summary": "Added raw_response column to store complete AI review output before parsing, plus minor fixes for task creation tags and title generation. Also cleaned up unused imports in test files.",
  "learnings": [
    {"topic": "Database updates", "reminder": "When adding new fields, consider if they can be included in the initial stored procedure call rather than a separate UPDATE query"},
    {"topic": "Task creation tags", "reminder": "Always use parameterized queries ($4, $5) for dynamic tags instead of hardcoded values in SQL"},
    {"topic": "Finding objects", "reminder": "Use fallback chain like `finding.message || finding.suggestion || finding.file` to handle potentially undefined fields"},
    {"topic": "Import cleanup", "reminder": "Remove unused imports during refactoring to keep code clean"}
  ],
  "issues": [
    {
      "severity": "low",
      "location": "src/services/InterReviewService.ts:206-209",
      "description": "rawResponse stored in separate UPDATE after main stored procedure - could cause data inconsistency if this second query fails",
      "suggestion": "Consider modifying update_inter_review stored procedure to accept raw_response as 12th parameter, or add transaction/rollback logic"
    }
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "The separate UPDATE for raw_response (lines 206-209) could fail silently. Consider wrapping both operations in a transaction or including raw_response in the original stored procedure call",
    "Migration uses 'IF NOT EXISTS' which is good for idempotency, but the GIN index on text column might be expensive for large tables - consider if full-text search is needed"
  ],
  "praise": [
    "Good fix on line 718: using fallback chain for title generation prevents undefined errors",
    "Good fix on line 731: now correctly parameterizes finding.type and finding.severity in tags",
    "Good cleanup of unused imports in test files",
    "Migration is idempotent (uses IF NOT EXISTS)"
  ],
  "overallScore": 88,
  "codeQualityScore": 85,

  "documentationScore": 80
}
